title: Add retry with exponential backoff to the HTTP client

extra_prompt_vars.task_summary: Wrap `HttpClient.get` in a retry loop: up to 3 attempts on connection errors and HTTP 502/503/504, with exponential backoff starting at 0.5s and full jitter. Do not retry any other 4xx or 5xx. Add tests that inject a fake transport; do not sleep for real in tests.
extra_prompt_vars.shape_guidance: Keep the public signature of `HttpClient.get` unchanged. No new dependencies. Put the backoff calculation in a small pure function so it can be tested directly.
